components.name: Chart/Network graph
components.description: Connections between entities (products, accounts, services, transfers). Node size = degree or volume, colour = group, links in dataviz/axis. Max ~40 nodes; Focus highlights one node and its neighbours, the rest at layer opacity 25%. Mobile: show 1-level neighbours only. React: <NetworkGraph nodes links focus? />
